_meanings:
.²1 Accomplishment, fulfilment, completion, perfection, complete attainment
 (of an object); {#viroDi sidDeriti kartumudyataH#} <ls>Ki. 14. 8</ls>; {#kriyAsidDiH#}
 {#sattve Bavati mahatAM nopakaraRe#} <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>
.²2 Success, prosperity, welfare, well-being.
.²3 Establishment, settlement.
.²4 Substantiation, demonstration, proof, indisputable conclusion.
.²5 Validity (of a rule, law <ab>&c.</ab>).
.²6 Decision, adjudication, settlement (of a law-suit); {#kAryakAraRasidDO#}
 {#ca prasannA budDiravyayA#} <ls>Rām. 4. 18. 47</ls>;
 {#tasmAnna leKasAmarTyAt sidDirEkAntikI matA#} <ls>Śukra. 4. 726</ls>.
.²7 Certainty, truth, accuracy, correctness.
.²8 Payment, liquidation (of a

 debt); {#aDamarRArTasidDaparTamuttamarRena coditaH#} <ls>Ms. 8. 47</ls>.
.²9 Preparing, cooking (as of drugs <ab>&c.</ab>).
.²10 The solution of a problem.
.²11 Readiness.
.²12 Complete purity or sanctification.
.²13 A superhuman power or faculty; (these faculties are eight:-- {#aRimA#}
 {#laGimA prAptiH prAkAmyaM mahimA taTA . ISitvaM ca vaSitvaM ca taTA kAmAvasAyitA ..#}).
.²14 The acquisition of supernatural powers by magical means.
.²15 Marvellous skill or capability.
.²16 Good effect or result.
.²17 Final beatitude, final emancipation.
.²18 Understanding, intellect.
.²19 Concealment, vanishing, making oneself invisible.
.²20 A magical shoe (supposed to convey the wearer wherever he likes).
.²21 A kind of Yoga.
.²22 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
.²23 Complete knowledge.
.²24 Advantage, use, good effect.
.²25 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva ({%m.%} in this sense).
.²26 Efficacy, efficiency.
.²27 Becoming intelligible (as sounds or words).
.²28 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The pointing out in the same person of various good qualities.
a particular auspicious conjunction of planets.
